format: lightsuffer-ios CPU auto-exposure common fixture v2

notes.float_format: scalar floats use 7 significant digits; images, previews and pipeline taps use base64 little-endian float32 in C order
notes.packing: each packed array records shape, dtype, encoding and the SHA-256 of its unencoded float32 bytes
notes.source_quantization: source images are rounded to float32 and converted back to float64 before the unmodified upstream calls, so the stored sources and rgb_in taps are exact
notes.preview: ResizingService.small_preview(image) with the default max_size=256 and order=0. The metering input long edge is 320, so the linear and encoded previews are both downsampled. Their complete upstream arrays are included for sampling diagnostics.
notes.pipeline_input: the separate 48 x 32 pipeline source is at or below the preview limit; downscale coverage comes from the metering image
notes.unknown_method: 'not_a_metering_method' intentionally exercises the upstream unknown-method fallback (exposure=1, EV=0).

linear_prophoto.description: 320 x 32 deterministic bright centre, dark edges and colour gradients

srgb_encoded.description: the linear image clipped to [0, 1] and encoded with the sRGB inverse EOTF

linear_prophoto.description: 48 x 32 deterministic source for the three full-pipeline cases
